mode.title: Apply mode
mode.off_hint: Auto is off. Boba prepares applications; you send them.
mode.on_hint: Auto sends the offers that clear a rule's thresholds and caps.
mode.needs_rule: Auto stays off until you add at least one rule.

confirm.title: Turn on auto-apply?
confirm.body: Boba will prepare and send applications by itself, with the documents it already verified. You can stop it at any time.
confirm.caps: It never goes past {cap} applications a day across every rule, and each rule has its own caps and active hours.
confirm.review_first: Every automatic send is logged, and the reasons for every refusal are kept.
confirm.accept: I understand and want Auto to send for me

rules.title: Auto Rules
rules.empty: No rules yet. A rule says which Sources and channels may be applied to automatically, and how good the offer has to be.

form.title: Auto Rule
form.name: Rule name
form.sources_hint: One Source id per line. Leave it empty to cover every Source.
form.session_board_hint: Session Board needs that Source's own Auto opt-in, so it cannot be chosen here yet.

settings.title: Caps and timing
settings.spacing: Automatic sends are 5–20 minutes apart, inside the active hours.
settings.reset_confirm: This turns Auto off and restores the default caps (5 a day per rule, 1 per company per 30 days). Your rules stay.

check.title: Why would Auto send this?
check.hint: Pick an application and a channel to see the decision the core makes, with its reasons.
check.none: No applications in the Tracker yet.
check.auto: Auto would send this under rule {rule}.
check.review: A human keeps this one. Reasons:

reason.auto_not_confirmed: Auto was not turned on with the confirmation dialog.
reason.no_rule_for_source: No Auto Rule covers this Source.
reason.no_rule_for_channel: No Auto Rule covers this channel ({channel}).
reason.rank_missing: This offer has no Rank Score yet.
reason.fit_missing: This offer has no Fit Score yet.
reason.flag_not_allowed: The posting raised a FLAG and this rule does not allow FLAGs.
reason.fraud_badge: The posting carries a fraud badge.
reason.documents_unverified: The documents are not verified yet.
reason.language_variant_unconfirmed: A document's language variant is not confirmed.
reason.duplicate: You already applied to this company for a similar role.
reason.cli_without_lockdown: The agent CLI has no verified tool lockdown.
reason.source_without_opt_in: This Source's Auto opt-in is not active.
reason.global_cap_reached: The global cap of {cap} applications a day is reached.
reason.rule_daily_cap_reached: This rule's cap of {cap} a day is reached.
reason.company_cap_reached: The limit of {cap} per company per {days} days is reached.
reason.spacing_not_elapsed: Wait {wait_minutes} more minutes between automatic sends.
reason.session_cap_reached: This Source already sent its {cap} automatic applications today.
reason.session_spacing_not_elapsed: Wait {wait_minutes} more minutes: automatic applications on this Source stay at least 10 minutes apart.

error.load: Boba could not load the Apply settings.
error.save: Boba could not save the rule. Check the values and try again.
error.delete: Boba could not delete the rule.
error.reset: Boba could not reset the Apply settings.
error.cap: Boba could not save the global cap.
error.explain: Boba could not check that application.
